s4-thief.desc: a man by the mall benches

s4-colleague.desc: a clerk from the next kiosk

extra:sibling.desc: a young resident with a mall pass

stub-on-the-floor.1.1.line: {s4-owner} sits on a sky mall bench counting paper stubs from a brown envelope.

stub-on-the-floor.1.2.line: {s4-owner} knocks {s4-owner.his} bag with an elbow, and a stub flutters to the floor.

stub-on-the-floor.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} stoops and lifts the fallen stub off the floor.

stub-on-the-floor.1.5.line: {rookie-officer} reads the stub as {s4-owner} takes it: a printed row of numbers and a handwritten 3.

envelope-lifted.1.1.line: {s4-owner} sits on the same bench with the brown envelope on {s4-owner.his} knee.

envelope-lifted.1.2.line: {s4-owner} sets the envelope down on the bench and walks off toward the tea kiosk.

envelope-lifted.1.3.line: {s4-thief} walks past the bench a minute after the clerk leaves, a gray hood bunched in one hand.

envelope-lifted.1.4.line: {s4-thief} scoops the brown envelope off the bench without breaking stride.

envelope-lifted.1.5.line: {s4-thief} walks on toward the lift with the envelope tucked under one arm.

envelope-lifted.1.6.line: {s4-owner} comes back from the tea kiosk with a cup in hand.

envelope-lifted.1.7.line: {s4-owner} points at the empty bench where the envelope sat.

envelope-lifted.1.8.line: {s4-owner} pulls a spare stub from {s4-owner.his} pocket and gives it to {rookie-officer}.

two-envelopes.1.1.line: {s4-teen} jumps up from a nearby bench and runs.

two-envelopes.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} runs after {s4-teen}, notebook flapping in one hand.

two-envelopes.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} clips the bag of {extra:shopper} with one shoulder and keeps running.

two-envelopes.1.4.line: {s4-colleague} walks past the bench carrying a brown envelope.

screen-still.1.1.line: {rookie-officer} reads a still on the mall screen: a gray hood at the bench, stamped "16:06."

screen-still.1.2.line: {s4-owner} tells {rookie-officer} it was just paper stubs, nothing anyone would pay for.

hold-back.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} argues with {rookie-officer} in the lift hall: "You ran. Nobody else did."

hold-back.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} points at the notebook in {rookie-officer.his} hand.

hold-back.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} shrugs and looks at the floor.

hold-back.1.4.line: {rookie-officer} sits down on a lift hall seat, notebook on {rookie-officer.his} knee.

teen-cleared.1.1.line: {s4-teen} waits by the bench with a satchel, watching the lift doors.

teen-cleared.1.2.line: {s4-teen} hugs {extra:sibling} as the lift doors open.

teen-cleared.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} reads the mall pass {extra:sibling} holds up: "Entered 16:07."

badge-on-the-stair.1.1.line: {s4-thief} walks to the staff stair, a gray hood bunched in one hand.

badge-on-the-stair.1.2.line: {s4-thief} stands at the staff door with a lanyard turned inward.

badge-on-the-stair.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} reads the number on the lanyard of {s4-thief} as it swings: 22.

same-bench-16-00.1.1.line: {rookie-officer} watches the bench from the tea kiosk, cup in hand.

same-bench-16-00.1.2.line: {s4-thief} sits down on the bench across from the tea kiosk, a gray hood over one knee.

same-bench-16-00.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} searches through the bin beside the bench.

same-bench-16-00.1.4.line: {rookie-officer} lifts a wad of perforated paper stubs out of the bin.

colleague-cleared.1.1.line: {s4-colleague} hands {s4-owner} a brown envelope across the kiosk counter.

colleague-cleared.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} reads the label on the envelope {s4-owner} holds: "Staff memo."

arrest-on-the-bench.1.1.line: {rookie-officer} waits at the tea kiosk, eyes on the bench.

arrest-on-the-bench.1.2.line: {s4-thief} sits down on the bench, a gray hood over one knee.

arrest-on-the-bench.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} stands still at the kiosk and does not run.

arrest-on-the-bench.1.4.line: {rookie-officer} walks to the bench and arrests {s4-thief}.

arrest-on-the-bench.1.5.line: {rookie-officer} walks {s4-thief} to the lift in cuffs.

arrest-on-the-bench.1.6.line: {rookie-officer} pulls a paper stub from the pocket of {s4-thief}, a handwritten 3 on its row.

statement.1.1.line: {s4-thief} sits at the interview table, a gray hood folded in front of {s4-thief.him}.

statement.1.2.line: {s4-thief} tells {rookie-officer} a stranger paid {s4-thief.him} forty credits to lift whatever lay on the bench.

statement.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} logs the statement and reads it back from the screen.

envelope-back.1.1.line: {rookie-officer} hands the envelope of stubs back to {s4-owner} on the lawn.

envelope-back.1.2.line: {s4-owner} signs the return sheet {rookie-officer} holds out.

envelope-back.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} hugs {extra:relative} on the lawn, then straightens {rookie-officer.his} uniform.

envelope-back.1.4.line: {rookie-officer} sits on the lawn and reads through {rookie-officer.his} notebook.
